title: montia fontana subsp. verna
intro: Montia fontana subsp. verna, commonly known as spring purslane, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Montiaceae. It has been used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its health benefits in treating digestive issues and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of spring purslane are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the digestive system, while its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, contribute to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. Additionally, spring purslane has been used to treat various conditions, including diarrhea, constipation, and respiratory issues, due to its emollient, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory effects.
